name: Logical Knowledge Base
description: A LogicalKnowledgeBase document (schema 1.0.0) as an FDPM profile: 115 node kinds as primitive types, every Reference field as a typed edge, the formula/term/type/concept languages as schema-validated JSON, whole-document verification through the vendored root schema, an lkb-json importer/exporter, a theory listing and an argument graph.

metadata.description: Every node's fields parse against its own arm of the vendored schema (references and provenance excluded, they are edges).
A reference edge carrying target_family points at a node of that family (upstream matchesTargetFamily).
local references target document nodes, imported/external ones an lkb:ExternalTarget; external ones carry external_uri.
Predicate and function applications inside formulas match the declared arity (variadic-aware).
priorityOver and overrides edges between rules form no cycle.
A module, world, jurisdiction, organization or security domain does not parent itself.
The derived lkb:mentions edges agree with the node's formulas (warning; reconcileMentions repairs).
A grounded framework's declared acceptedArguments equals the computed grounded extension (warning).

The workbook assembles into a document the vendored root schema accepts: id uniqueness, unresolved references, variable scope, side-effect approval and every other whole-document check upstream defines.
A LogicalKnowledgeBase JSON document; parsed by the root schema, then split into primitives and edges.
Canonical LogicalKnowledgeBase JSON of the workbook; refuses a workbook that does not assemble into a valid document.
